steps.title: Quick check
steps.question: What is the purpose of a refresher course?
steps.feedback: A refresher should reinforce and verify knowledge already acquired.

questions.text: Which statement best describes refresher training?
choices: It removes the need for competency checks
It must always last four hours
questions.feedback: Refresher training is intended to reinforce and verify existing knowledge.

questions.text: A refresher course can use short interactive checks throughout the module.
questions.feedback: Short checks can reinforce key information and improve engagement.
